title: The Western Path Returning to Itself

features.name: the western fork
features.desc-on-touch: The path splits and keeps splitting. You have walked this fork before and find yourself here again, but changed.

features.name: the argument crystallized
features.desc-on-touch: Where the valley's fork has learned to love both paths equally. The choice was never the point—the walking was.

features.name: the stone where walkers rest
features.desc-on-touch: Every loop brings new people to this place. The stone remembers all the different ways they approached the same fork.

features.name: the learning edge
features.desc-on-touch: Where the path has worn smooth from many walkers returning to the same choice. The argument has become sacred from use.

features.name: the return marker
features.desc-on-touch: You recognize this. You have been here before and will come back again. The argument was never about resolution—it was about returning.

features.name: the testament
features.desc-on-touch: A marker carved by someone who had walked this loop many times. The words are worn smooth but still readable: both paths were right.

inscription: the argument never ends because the valley loves both paths equally; settlement would kill the conversation; return is how the fork stays alive
